title: The Late Shift
description: A stranger walks into an all-night diner off Route 9, clutching something she won't let go of. A quiet, character-driven mystery you steer. The canonical Focused Simple Start example for the AI Dungeon skill.
prompt:
Rain needles the windows and the coffee's gone bitter on the burner. Past two, and the booths are empty except for a trucker asleep over his pie. Del works the crossword by the register, glasses down his nose.

The bell over the door jangles. A woman steps in out of the dark, soaked through, clutching a paper bag to her chest like it might bolt. She scans the empty room and comes straight for your counter.
plotEssentials:
You are ${character.name}, ${character.gender}, ${Describe yourself in second person, e.g. "You have dark hair and tired eyes."}.

You're the night cook at the Stardust Diner off Route 9, the only place open past midnight for thirty miles. Del, the owner, works the register; he's known you since you were a kid.
authorsNote:
Perspective: Second Person Present from ${character.name}'s point of view.
Prioritize complex personality over flat statements; let people be tired, evasive, funny.
